audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the final 42 Stardew Valley 1.6 strings covering foods, catalogues, renovations, pet adoption, professions and options. Canonical pet, trinket, bobber, cave, profession and machine terms, gender catalogue suffixes, compound slash-field arity, placeholders and dialogue markers were checked against the English source.
